        • Serialized Fields

          • correlationId
            String correlationId
            The SDK-generated request correlation id (X-Correlation-Id header value) of the request that produced this error, or null for errors constructed outside the HTTP layer. Quote this id when raising the failure with Equinix support — the same id was sent to the API and appears in the SDK's request/retry logs.
